title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-k1jp: transcript_4 incorrectly adds cred to TH_4 hash, violating RFC 9528
description: Commit 6de351fc8f modified transcript_4 in rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs to include cred in the hash computation. Per RFC 9528 Section 4.1, TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3) — the credential is NOT part of the TH_4 input. The credential was already included transitively via the hash chain (CRED_R in TH_2, CRED_I in TH_3). Adding cred to TH_4 is a spec violation that would produce incorrect transcript hashes, breaking authentication with any RFC 9528-compliant implementation. The original code (with _cred prefixed as unused) was correct. Fix: revert the added encode_bstr(&mut buf, cred)?; line and restore the _cred prefix.
